A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CoTo research work. Their complete texts, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendices B–C report original CoTo experiments on classification, reasoning, adapter merging, pruning, and training behavior.

after.justification: The same original CoTo experimental results remain in Section 4 and Appendices B–C, alongside explicitly attributed baseline results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same stochastic adapter activation procedure, optimization objective, and schedule reaching full activation after 75% of training.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same image classification, commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning, language understanding, and image generation tasks, including all appendix evaluations.

E2.justification: The comparator sets and CoTo pairings are unchanged in the corresponding benchmark and merging experiments, including Tables 1–4 and 11.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain the same experimental settings, including 16-shot image classification, model backbones, adapter ranks, learning rates, metrics, and merging and pruning procedures.

E4.justification: The alignment, pruning, adapter-contribution, hyperparameter-sensitivity, activation-schedule, and convergence analyses are unchanged in Sections 4.2–4.5 and Appendices B–C.

E5.justification: The three-seed reporting statement, five-seed convergence analysis, error bars, and standard-deviation reporting in Table 9 are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples match, including the appendix results. For example, Table 3 retains 57.16 ± 0.38% accuracy for LoRA-Pro with CoTo.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, cooperative-game formulation, Theorem 3.1, and its proof in Appendix D are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about generalization, linear mode connectivity, merging, pruning robustness, and computational savings.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning balanced adapter utilization, lazy training, and dropout stability are unchanged. Section 5 and Appendix C retain the same qualifications and future directions.

D1.justification: The implementation description, hyperparameters in Tables 8 and 10, hardware and timing information, and code/data access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works, and the reference list are unchanged; CoTo's positioning relative to earlier methods remains the same.

P1.justification: The acknowledgement changes the grant identifier from 2022YFA1004102 to 2022ZD0160300, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Small spacing and text-flow adjustments on pages 1–3 change column and page breaks. Figures and tables retain their content and design, and all appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: The grant-identifier update, version stamp, and minor layout adjustments leave the paper's scientific argument, evidence, and reproducibility information unchanged. The complete appendices are identical, supporting no meaningful overall quality difference.
